versions.changelog:
Initial public release of Afterself — a digital legacy agent for managing your online presence when you're unavailable.

- Heartbeat protocol: Periodic check-ins to confirm owner is active; triggers escalation and executor if missed.
- Executor: Executes owner-defined final wishes (messages, emails, account closures, crypto transfers) upon confirmed absence.
- Escalation protocol: Notifies trusted contacts and processes their responses if owner is unreachable.
- Ghost mode: Optionally continues communication in the owner's style after trigger.
- Strict consent, privacy, and transparency ethics baked in; all data remains local.
